channel.title: FXStreet Forex & Commodities News
channel.description: Real-time Forex News and the latest trading updates. Stay updated on the latest news about currencies and commodities markets.

item.title: Canada CPI Preview: Inflation expected to tick higher in May, pressuring BoC outlook
item.description: The publication of Canada’s May Consumer Price Index (CPI) figures on Monday will be the focus of attention.

item.title: British Pound: Political change and flows – BNY
item.description: BNY’s Geoff Yu highlights that Sir Keir Starmer’s resignation and the likely appointment of Andy Burnham as Prime Minister are largely priced into U.K. assets.

item.title: Euro: Test of 1.140 seen before recovery against US Dollar – ING
item.description: ING’s Francesco Pesole sees a decent risk that EUR/USD will need to test 1.140 as lingering post-Fed Dollar momentum plays out before any renewed upward pattern.

item.title: US VP Vance: Set up mechanism to keep the Hormuz open
item.description: United States (US) Vice President (VP) JD Vance said during the European trading session on Monday that mechanisms have set up to keep the Strait of Hormuz, a vital passage to almost 20% of global energy supply, open, and stop hostilities in Lebanon.

item.title: Canada: Inflation seen firming with energy support – TD Securities
item.description: TD Securities strategists expect Canada’s May Consumer Price Index (CPI) to rise, with headline inflation projected at 3.1% year-on-year and 0.8% month-on-month, driven by higher energy prices and seasonal factors.

item.title: Canadian Dollar underperforms ahead of inflation data for May
item.description: The Canadian Dollar (CAD) trades lower against its major currency peers during the European trading session on Monday, ahead of the Consumer Price Index (CPI) data for May, which will be published at 12:30 GMT.

item.title: Japanese Yen dips despite warnings as Fed hike bets, Iran tensions lift US Dollar
item.description: USD/JPY advances toward 161.70 on Monday, gaining around 0.25% at the time of writing, as the US Dollar (USD) benefits from both renewed risk aversion linked to geopolitical tensions in the Middle East and stronger expectations for tighter monetary policy in the United States (US).

item.title: Fed: Warsh signals tighter path – Deutsche Bank
item.description: Deutsche Bank strategists report that after a hawkish Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) under new Chair Kevin Warsh, they now forecast two 25 bps Fed hikes in 2026, likely in September and December, taking the fed funds rate to around 4.1%.

item.title: Indian Rupee declines as Fed likely to hike interest rates at least twice this year
item.description: The Indian Rupee (INR) trades lower against the US Dollar (USD) in India's afternoon trading hours on Monday. The USD/INR pair rises to near 94.75 as the US Dollar outperforms its peers amid expectations that the Federal Reserve (Fed) will deliver at least two interest rate hikes this year.

item.title: AUD/USD Price Forecast: Could slide to 0.6900 if breaks below 0.6980
item.description: The Australian Dollar (AUD) trades slightly lower at around 0.7003 against the US Dollar (USD) during the European trading session on Monday.

item.title: British Pound jumps against the Japanese Yen as UK PM Starmer steps down
item.description: The British Pound (GBP) accelerates its recovery against the Japanese Yen (JPY) on Monday to test levels above 214.00 at the time of writing. The Sterling is being boosted across the board, as investors welcome the decision of the United Kingdom Prime Minister, Keir Starmer, to step down.

item.title: Euro slips against British Pound after UK Prime Minister Starmer steps down
item.description: EUR/GBP comes under pressure on Monday as markets react positively to UK Prime Minister Keir Starmer's resignation, with the British Pound (GBP) outperforming most of its major peers.

item.title: Japanese Yen: BoJ tightening fails to lift Japanese Yen – OCBC
item.description: OCBC strategists Sim Moh Siong and Christopher Wong note that the Bank of Japan’s (BoJ) 25 bp hike to 1.0% and confirmation of tapering ending in 2027 have not materially supported the Japanese Yen (JPY).

item.title: Euro advances as Eurozone PMIs and Lagarde speeches take focus while Yen stays pressured
item.description: EUR/JPY advances toward 185.30 on Monday, gaining 0.16% at the time of writing, as markets prepare for the release of the Eurozone’s preliminary HCOB Purchasing Managers Index (PMI) data and closely watch speeches from the President of the European Central Bank (ECB).

item.title: Brent: Talks ease supply risk – Deutsche Bank
item.description: Deutsche Bank strategists note that Brent Oil has reversed earlier gains as progress in US–Iran talks reduces fears over disruptions at the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Silver price today: Silver rises, according to FXStreet data
item.description: Silver prices (XAG/USD) rose on Monday, according to FXStreet data. Silver trades at $66.33 per troy ounce, up 2.30% from the $64.84 it cost on Friday.

item.title: Gold: Losses extend with higher-for-longer Fed – ING
item.description: ING strategists Warren Patterson and Ewa Manthey say Gold fell for a third straight session and week, losing over 2% as investors reassessed US-Iran negotiations and US monetary policy.

item.title: British Pound edges up above 1.3200 after PM Keir Starmer’s resignation
item.description: The British Pound (GBP) nudged up above 1.3200 against the US Dollar (USD) on Monday and maintains a mild positive tone, despite news that Sir Keir Starmer resigned as Prime Minister of the United Kingdom and Leader of the Labour Party.

item.title: US Dollar: Stronger footing with higher yields – MUFG
item.description: MUFG’s Lee Hardman notes the US Dollar remains firm after last week’s breakout, driven by a hawkish repricing of Fed rate hike expectations and a rebound in US yields. Markets now see roughly even odds of a near-term Fed hike, even as Oil prices fall on progress in US-Iran talks.

item.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD holds gains near $66.00 on US-Iran peace progress
item.description: Silver price (XAG/USD) advances after three days of losses, hovering around $66.00 per troy ounce during the European hours on Monday. However, Silver price gains ground as oil prices and inflation concerns ease following a positive development regarding the United States (US)-Iran peace deal.

item.title: NZD/USD drops to fresh low since April vs bullish USD amid hawkish Fed, Iran uncertainty
item.description: The NZD/USD pair drifts lower for the fourth consecutive day – also marking the sixth day of a negative move in the previous seven – and drops to its lowest level since April 8 during the first half of the European session on Monday.

item.title: Canadian Dollar: Downtrend extends versus US Dollar – Societe Generale
item.description: Societe Generale highlights that USD/CAD has accelerated higher after breaking a descending trend line in place since last year, signalling a momentum shift and an attempted breakout from a broad multi-month range.

item.title: AUD/USD Price Forecast: Dips below 0.7000, nearing 11-week lows
item.description: The Australian Dollar (AUD) extends losses against the US Dollar (USD) for the fifth consecutive day on Monday, trading just below the psychological 0.7000 level and drifting towards the 11-week low of 0.6979.

item.title: Australian Dollar strengthens against Japanese Yen due to carry-trades
item.description: AUD/JPY holds gains after experiencing volatility, trading around 113.10 during the European hours on Monday. The currency cross remains heavily bid as the Japanese Yen (JPY) continues to lose ground to widespread carry-trade activity.

item.title: Breaking: UK PM Starmer resigns, says nominations will open July 9
item.description: United Kingdom (UK) Prime Minister Keir Starmer announces his resignation and says that nominations for new contender will open on July 9.

item.title: Australian Dollar: Downward bias toward 0.6980 versus US Dollar – UOB
item.description: United Overseas Bank’s (UOB) Quek Ser Leang and Lee Sue Ann keep a negative stance on AUD/USD after a period of quiet price action around 0.7020.

item.title: Euro weakens against US Dollar as hawkish Fed bets hog limelight
item.description: The Euro (EUR) trades 0.23% lower against the US Dollar (USD) at around 1.1444 during the European trading session on Monday.

item.title: Gold lacks bullish conviction near $4,200 as Fed hike bets and Iran risks underpin USD
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) maintains its bid tone near the $4,200 mark through the first half of the European session on Monday and, for now, seems to have snapped a three-day losing streak, to a more than one-week low set the previous day. item.title: USD/CHF Price Forecast: Looking overstretched at YTD highs near 0.8100
item.description: The US Dollar (USD) keeps marching higher against the Swiss Franc (CHF) on Monday, trading at year-to-date highs around 0.8085 at the time of writing and starting to look overstretched after having rallied nearly 2% over the last four trading days.The US Dollar is drawing support from monetary poli

item.title: Euro: Pressured as US Dollar stays firm – Danske Bank
item.description: Danske Research Team notes that EUR/USD extended its latest decline on Friday, breaking firmly below the 1.15 mark as European yields rose in a bearish steepening.
